description: Two model years side by side on the figures that decide most purchases: fuel economy or EV range, Safety Signal grade, recalls, complaints, crash rating and starting price where a press kit is on file.

a.description: Vehicle id for the first car, e.g. 2021_kia_telluride. Get one from search_vehicles.

b.description: Vehicle id for the second car, e.g. 2021_honda_pilot. Get one from search_vehicles. Must be a different id from `a`.

name: compare_vehicles
